sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Acute gastritis, severe pain in epigas-
trium ; prolonged vomiting. Uncontrollable appetite, not-
withstanding irritable stomach. Gastralgia from nervous
depression, (Give five drops of lx of Oil.)

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Smarting and burning. Intense erythema,
worse, cold bathing ; better, olive oil and cool air blowing
on part.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Spircea. Gaultheria con-
tains Arbutin. Salycyl. acid. Methylium salicylicum
(an artificial Gaultheria oil for rheumatism, especially
when the salicylates cannot be used. Pruritus and epi-
didymitis, locally). After Cantharis in burns.
